uncertain_terms.note: Manifest language is 'ar' but the body is mostly English: ~30.4% of body characters are Arabic. Written as AR→EN per the batch rule for mixed crane docs: Arabic fragments translated (guided by the English counterpart page gen-docs-cranes-page-htm), English body carried verbatim.
Garbled OCR fragment in the station column (rows Crane-002..005): 'دي ملاحظة' is a misreading of 'dy PS'; rendered as 'Nag Hamady PS' per the English counterpart page.
Arabic-letter maintenance codes (م = month-based code) rendered as Latin M6/M1/M3 per the English counterpart page.
Arabic transliteration of manufacturer name STAHL; rendered as 'STAHL'.
Arabic transliteration of 'Hamon Sobelco'; rendered as in the English counterpart page.
Arabic transliteration of 'Waagner Biro Audria'; rendered as in the English counterpart page (source spelling 'Audria' kept).
Garbled Arabic description for Crane-020 ('power 10,265 ton house cranes'); rendered as '10, 265 Ton Power House Cranes' per the English counterpart page.
Arabic fragment for Crane-022 rendered as 'Cranes Racking m/c' per the English counterpart page.
A dangling 'Note:' label with no note content follows the station name in the source; carried as 'Note:' with no content added.
Garbled model string in Crane-001 description; carried verbatim.
Translated as 'Maintenance Procedure Information System' (no '(MPIS)' suffix in the source heading).
